reversal_on_the_odd_cells.statement: a half-turn of the frame about an axis through an even cell (spin part alpha_j alpha_k, an element of the tick's quaternion group) commutes with every sub-step, fixes each kind of even cell and translates the kinds of odd cells by the group element of its axis; about axis 3 this is the reversal 0<->3, 1<->2
reversal_on_the_odd_cells.consequence: cases D and E are images of each other under a symmetry that leaves the reference case A unchanged: same levels, same mixing. The three double transpositions of the odd kinds are all of this type.

one_kind_lifted.reading: a state on one kind of cell is the equal-weight combination of the four cones (signs = a character of the group of kinds) and, as an eigenstate of Y_record, an equal mixture of the two arrow classes; a source on one kind lifts it alone (rank one, level = half the kind angle = four times the lattice average of a one-kind source) and leaves three copies at rest

conditions.K2 quotient: Q = sum of squares / (sum)^2 = 1/3 + (2/3) |b|^2 / a^2; Q = 2/3 exactly when |b|/a = 1/sqrt2 (balance)
conditions.K3 attachment: the eigenvalues are square roots of masses, m_k = s lambda_k^2 with one scale s, on the positive chamber (all lambda_k >= 0; for the balanced modulus |delta| <= pi/12 modulo 2 pi/3); C_mass = (Y^+ Y)^(1/4)
conditions.K4 phase: not selected by the identity; the packet's geometric connection gives loop phases in multiples of pi/10 (spin one half) and pi/5 (spin one), link phase one third of a loop: classes delta = 0, pi/30, pi/15
conditions.K5 balanced source: a configured coherent source with native record weights (10, 5, 5, 2, 50)/72: a = sqrt(10/72), |b| = sqrt(5/72), so |b|/a = 1/sqrt2; its phase is supplied, not selected
conditions.K7 conditional third mass: sqrt(m3) = 2 (x + y) + sqrt(3 (x^2 + 4 x y + y^2)) from two masses under balance
